metadata.title: torch.randperm given GPU random generator raise error

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



<!-- torch.randperm raise RuntimeError when I set both default tensor type and Generator device to GPU -->

trigger_conditions.condition: Calling CUDA APIs with non-canonical device specifications or inconsistent device identifiers, such as using "cuda" instead of "cuda:0", which may trigger incorrect device validation.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: torch.randperm is called with a CUDA Generator created with device='cuda' (non-canonical device string), while the validation expects 'cuda:0'.

failure_behavior.description: torch.randperm is called with a CUDA Generator created with device='cuda' (non-canonical device string), while the validation expects 'cuda:0'.
